title: After US Open, Eala sets sights on Singapore tourney

blocks.text: Alex Eala will have plenty of time to rest for her next competition following her third-round finish at the US Open in New York over the weekend. The 21-year-old Eala is listed to compete in the Singapore Open, a WTA 500 event scheduled on Sept. 21 to 27 at the OCBC Arena. It served as the first tournament in the Asian swing. Based on the latest player list, the tournament draws three of the world’s top 10 players in No. 3 Jessica Pegula, No. 5 and French Open champion Mirra Andreeva, as well as No. 10 and two-time Grand Slam finalist Amanda Anisimova. Other players also competing are two-time Grand Slam champion Barbora Krejcikova, Anastasia Potapova, Donna Vejic and fellow Southeast Asian standout Janice Tjen of Indonesia. The tournament also serves as a prelude to Eala’s reported participation in the 2026 Asian Games in Japan, where competition starts on Sept. 27 to Oct. 2. Currently ranked No. 18, Eala hopes to ride on the momentum of her strong run over the past months, that include her historic fourth-round finish at the Wimbledon, winning her breakthrough WTA title at the Mubadala DC Open in Washington, DC, and her third-round finish at the US Open.
